rulings.ruling: Ruling: finding; IT-2 (2025) p. 2, Boxes 15a through 17a: "If you have no New York State wages or withholding, leave boxes 16a and 17a blank." The reply shows the whole-dollar box only when the amount is more than zero; the project shows it on every W-2 record, $0 when there is no withholding. The record is required for every W-2 (the basis of the 2026-11-04 model-error ruling), the box is not. Value expressions identical (half-up; "drop amounts below 50 cents and increase amounts from 50 to 99 cents to the next dollar"); presentation only. (BUG-0763)
